commands.command: QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev stack 55440> cargo test -p quansio-server --test live_sessions (takeover fences the same session and parks the run; a policy pause is shown and no handback undoes it; the native-computer takeover drives the control row with its fence — against real PostgreSQL)

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev stack 55440> (cd apps/desktop && pnpm exec vitest run tests/live.test.ts tests/live.e2e.test.ts tests/preload.test.ts) (single-session and terminal-replay unit tests; takeover + reconnect + handback E2E through the desktop bridge against the real quansio-server seeded by quansio-dev-seed --live)
QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev stack 55440> cargo test -p quansio-cli --test cli_e2e (targets list reads the served projection shape)

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev stack 55440> bash scripts/ci/ci.sh (cargo test --workspace, pnpm build/typecheck/test incl. every desktop, web and SDK E2E, eslint ., pytest, contract-drift, workspace, dossier, architecture, authority)
